subject: StratusAI - milestone-backed rebate request and MAP timeline
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <oliver@stratusai.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Commercial MAP and pilot timeline — StratusAI

Rachel / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and the cost profile you showed. We're ready to move from evaluation to a structured pilot, but procurement needs a formal mutual action plan (MAP) and a commercial commitment outline before we can sign the PO.

High-level ask: because we're committing to a 6-month ramp (pilot -> prod) with target committed tpm (tokens-per-month) milestones, StratusAI is asking for a milestone-backed rebate: 15–20% rebate on hosted usage during months 4–6 if we hit the following MAP milestones:
- M1 (30 days): technical integration + 1k concurrent queries load-tested
- M2 (90 days): production ingress + 25% of traffic routed to Redwood inference
- M3 (180 days): committed ramp of 5M tokens/month

We can share a signed MAP and PO once we have written confirmation of the rebate and the acceptance of the milestone definitions (we're fine with audit rights / monthly measurements). Attached is our draft MAP for your review (StratusAI_MAP_v2.pdf).

Next steps I'm proposing:
1) Redwood confirms commercial terms (rebate %, any prerequisites)
2) Agree MAP language and measurable criteria
3) Legal redlines exchanged and final PO submitted

Can you escalate internally on the rebate? Our procurement lead needs an approval note for the finance team.

— Oliver
StratusAI (Procurement)

Attachments: StratusAI_MAP_v2.pdf
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver@stratusai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Commercial MAP and pilot timeline — StratusAI

Oliver — appreciate the clarity and the draft MAP. Ben and I discussed internally and we think a milestone-backed rebate makes sense to accelerate commitment, but we need internal approvals for the percentage and gating language.

Summary of our proposal (internal ask):
- Proposal: 15% rebate on hosted usage months 4–6, contingent on the three milestones as defined.
- Conditions: quarterly audits of usage, clawback if metric manipulation is detected, and rebate applied as credit to hosted bills (not upfront).
- Recommended escalation: approval path required from VP Sales + CFO (and CEO for any rebate >10% as per policy).

I'm looping in Ben (AM), Laura (VP Sales), and Marcus (CFO) to request formal approval and to surface any finance/legal constraints.

Internal cc recipients: Ben Carter, Laura Bennett, Marcus Lin

I'll share the draft MAP and our recommended redlines in the internal thread.

— Rachel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: StratusAI MAP - rebate approval request

Laura / Marcus / Aditya — forwarding StratusAI's MAP + commercial ask. Recommendation: approve a 15% milestone-backed rebate, conditional on the MAP language below and contract clawbacks. This is high-propensity: StratusAI is evaluating two vendors and values the performance/observability we demonstrated. A controlled rebate tied to measurable MAP milestones accelerates our close and protects revenue.

Key commercial points:
- Proposed rebate: 15% credit on hosted consumption invoices for months 4–6, applied as offset to bills.
- Milestone measurement: usage telemetry (tokens/month) as reported by Redwood; StratusAI gets monthly measurement reports, Redwood reserves audit rights.
- Billing/recognition: rebate is credit; we do not record negative revenue upfront.
- Legal asks: added explicit clawback if KPIs show manipulation or if trial traffic is non-representative.

Attachments included: contract_redlines_v3.docx, finance_model_stratus.xlsx (ben prepared a quick model).

Requesting:
- Marcus: finance sign-off on rebate % / recognition treatment
- Laura: commercial OK on committing to 15% vs pushing for 20%
- Aditya: CEO approval required per policy if rebate >10%

Thanks — need an answer by EOD tomorrow if possible to keep procurement timelines intact.

Attachments: contract_redlines_v3.docx; finance_model_stratus.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Nov 2027 14:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: StratusAI MAP - rebate approval request

Team — reviewed Ben's model and Rachel's summary. A few items from finance: 
1) Recognize rebate as contra-revenue/credit applied in months 4–6; we need to make sure forecasts account for potential clawbacks.
2) We require an audit clause (internal/external) and a 30-day window to validate usage before rebate credit is applied.
3) Anything above 10% requires explicit CEO sign-off.

Provisional stance: finance is comfortable with up to 12% rebate with the clauses above and stronger gating on measurement. For commercial reasons we can accept 15% provisional if the CEO signs off. Marcus can sign a provisional approval memo (see attached stub cfo_approval_stub.pdf) to meet procurement timelines — contingent on final legal language.

Action items:
- Laura: recommend whether commercial pushes for 15% (and accept CEO escalation) or compromise at 12% to avoid escalation.
- Rachel/Ben: prep an amendment to the SOW that codifies the measurement and clawback timelines.
- Aditya: please advise; Rachel has requested an answer by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: cfo_approval_stub.pdf

— Marcus
Chief Financial Officer, Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 03 Nov 2027 15:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: StratusAI MAP - rebate approval request

Thanks for the context — good work surfacing the risks and the commercial upside. I authorize a one-time milestone-backed rebate of 15% on hosted usage months 4–6 for StratusAI under the following firm conditions: 
1) The MAP milestones MUST be explicitly measurable and auditable (as drafted).
2) Rebate applied as bill credit after finance validates monthly metrics; finance has a 30-day validation window before credit posts.
3) Full clawback language included for any confirmed manipulation or materially inaccurate traffic characterizations.
4) Legal to limit the scope to hosted usage only (no discounts on add-on professional services unless separately approved).

Laura / Rachel / Ben: proceed to finalize the SOW amendment and PO. Marcus: work with Legal on the final language and prepare the accounting memo for recognition. Rachel — please reply to Oliver with approved terms and attach the amendment once legal finishes redlines.

Aditya Rao
CEO, Redwood Inference
